capabilities: sync tagged Markdown tasks bidirectionally with a CalDAV server on file save
map multiple CalDAV calendars to different tags with separate credentials
store task UIDs as invisible HTML comments in notes
resolve conflicts between local checkbox state and remote VTODO status
verify CalDAV URLs and credentials with curl before setup
extras: Manifest carries the warning: "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff." README documents v1 limits: no background polling, no pulling remote-only tasks into notes, and no recurring tasks, due dates, or priorities.
problem: Obsidian tasks live only in notes, with no built-in way to keep them in sync with task lists on CalDAV servers like mailcow, SOGo, Nextcloud, or Baikal.

requires.name: A CalDAV server that supports VTODO (e.g. mailcow, SOGo, Nextcloud, Baikal)
Username and password for each mapped calendar

summary: Two-way sync that pushes Markdown tasks tagged with a configured tag to a CalDAV server and pulls remote status changes back.
